hints.title: Last Seen Indices
hints.text: Record the last index where each character appears in s.

hints.title: Ordered Character Accumulator
hints.text: Maintain an ordered sequence of characters chosen so far.

hints.title: Safe Eviction Condition
hints.text: When inspecting character c, if c is already chosen, skip it. Otherwise pop larger characters from the back if they appear again later.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each character pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all distinct letter subsequences takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack and seen set use O(sigma) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects monotonic stack with remaining frequency verification.
